messages:
jim_cust: Hey team — after the v2.8.1 model swap our app started getting malformed/shifted structured responses. Things I see: numeric IDs are quoted (\"12345\" instead of 12345), \n\"metadata\" sometimes appears as \"meta\" (different key), and the \"items\" array is intermittently missing (or coming back as an empty string). Example pair below (expected vs what we got).

jim_cust: Expected:
```json
{
  "order_id": 12345,
  "metadata": { "source": "checkout" },
  "items": [{"sku": "X", "qty": 2}]
}
```

jim_cust: Actual we received (from a single API call):
```json
{
  "order_id": "12345",
  "meta": { "source": "checkout" },
  "items": "[]"
}
```

olivia_support: Thanks @jim_cust — really sorry. Can you share the request ID / x-request-id from that response and whether you were using streaming or non-streaming mode? Also was this via hosted API or Dedicated?

jim_cust: request-id: r-0a1b2c3d, non-streaming (we call /v1/generate with JSON mode enabled). Hosted (api.redwood.example). Happens about 1/5 responses.

ravi_eng: tagging in. @olivia_support — quick Qs: were you using any batching on your client side, and did you set \"structured_output\": true or use the legacy \"json_mode\" flag? Also paste the exact prompt if you can (redact PII).

jim_cust: No batching on client. We pass \"structured_output\": true. Prompt is a template and small. Temp=0.0. We only started seeing this after the morning rollout to v2.8.1.

ravi_eng: This smells like a streaming/chunk boundary regression in the tokenizer->emitter path where arrays sometimes get emitted as quoted strings when the emission lands mid-token. But you said non-streaming — still possible if the runtime applies the same emitter path for safety. Will try to repro locally.

sara_qa: Repro steps I ran: pinned to v2.8.1, curl:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\n  -d '{\"structured_output\": true, \"prompt\": \"return order json for checkout\", \"max_tokens\": 200}'
```
I see ~15% of responses with \"items\": \"[]\" or \"order_id\": \"...\" on my run. Reverted to v2.8.0 and problem disappears.

ravi_eng: Good repro. I'm going to bisect kernel changes between 2.8.0 -> 2.8.1 for the emitter and tokenizer boundary handling. @deploy-bot can you confirm rollout metadata for the morning push?
\
deploy-bot: rollout v2.8.1 started 2026-03-17T09:12:10Z across hosted; 42% of traffic routed. No hotfixes applied yet.

ravi_eng: Thanks — looks like partial rollout might explain intermittent frequency. Short-term mitigation: set header `X-Redwood-Force-Strict-Json: true` to force the serializer to run a second-pass JSON validator and repair emitted tokens (costly but effective). Olivia, can you relay that to the customer and offer an immediate rollback for their org?

olivia_support: Will do. Jim — two options: 1) we can flip your org back to v2.8.0 immediately (no code change), or 2) add `X-Redwood-Force-Strict-Json: true` to your requests until we push a fix. Which do you prefer?

jim_cust: Please roll us back for now. Our service is sensitive to schema. Appreciate it.

olivia_support: Done — I requested an org-scoped rollback. Request ID for rollback: s-rollback-1122. Expect the change to propagate in ~5min. Also enabled temporary stricter JSON validation on your tenant while rollback completes.

ravi_eng: I've isolated the change: a performance tweak in the emitter that turned off a protective token-join step under certain kernel paths. Patch in review to restore the join but keep perf gains. Will target canary for 2.8.2 in ~2 hours and then a full rollout after QA.

sara_qa: We'll run targeted regression checks across structured-output workloads and add a test that confirms numeric tokens aren't quoted and arrays stay typed after serialization.

olivia_support: Follow-up for jim_cust — can you confirm once you see the rollback (or if you still see any bad payloads)? Sorry for the disruption.

jim_cust: Got rollback and traffic looks normal now. No quoted ids in sample checks. Thanks for quick turnaround.

ravi_eng: Filing root-cause ticket RN-9742 with reproducer, patch diff, and QA checklist. Will update this thread when 2.8.2 canary is live.

olivia_support: Closing loop here — keeping thread open until 2.8.2 rollout completes. :thumbsup:
